sections.title: Gasha Spots
sections.note: Tick a spot once you've harvested a nut there. A planted seed becomes a tree after 20 kills and bears a nut after 40 (half with the Gasha Ring).

items.name: Behind the Toilet in Lynna Village
items.howTo: Behind (just above) the Toilet building in Lynna Village. Bipin gives you a Gasha Seed in his house in the northwest of town.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 1–2

items.name: Yoll Graveyard, west side
items.area: West side, after the stairs down (Present)
items.howTo: On the western side of Yoll Graveyard after you descend the staircase (StrategyWiki: the southwest area).
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 2–4, or the one-time Piece of Heart

items.name: South Shore, west of the river
items.area: West side of the shore south of the Black Tower (Past)
items.howTo: From Rafton's house go north, then west, and swim across the river (StrategyWiki); the soil is at the far left of the shore south of the Black Tower.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 1–2

items.name: Crescent Island, southern plateau
items.area: High ledge on the south end (Present)
items.howTo: Climb the vines on a wall at the south end of Crescent Island; on the high ledge, lift the rocks to uncover the soil.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 2–4, or the one-time Piece of Heart

items.name: Crescent Island, northeast islet
items.howTo: An islet off Crescent Island's northeast corner. Swim there with Dimitri or the Mermaid Suit and cut the bushes to find the soil.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 2–4, or the one-time Piece of Heart

items.name: Crescent Island, south of the Tokay statue
items.howTo: On the platform just south of the one-eyed Tokay statue in the past, dig to uncover the soil. Get there on Rafton's raft, or later with the Mermaid Suit.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 3–5, or the one-time Piece of Heart
items.notes: The best spot in an unlinked Ages.

items.name: East of the Restoration Wall
items.area: Just east of the Restoration Wall (Past)
items.howTo: Leave Lynna Village to the west and go north to the rock formation east of the Restoration Wall; dig in its middle.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 2–4, or the one-time Piece of Heart

items.name: Nuun Highlands, northwest
items.howTo: In the northwest of the Nuun Highlands, drop to a high ledge and dig with the Shovel. Zelda Wiki says you need your animal companion to get there.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 2–4, or the one-time Piece of Heart

items.name: Rolling Ridge Base, southwest
items.area: Southwest edge, before the first cave (Past)
items.howTo: At the southwestern edge of Rolling Ridge Base, before you enter the first cave. StrategyWiki: one screen west after crossing the large pit; cut the bushes to reveal the soil.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 1–3

items.name: Rolling Ridge, central peak
items.area: Central peak, past the Crown Dungeon (Past)
items.howTo: On the central peak of Rolling Ridge in the past, reached from the Crown Dungeon. StrategyWiki: dig in the middle of three bushes on a ledge.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 1–3

items.name: Rolling Ridge, by Target Carts
items.howTo: Southwest of the Target Carts on Rolling Ridge; StrategyWiki: lift the rocks in a formation near the vine wall.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 1–3

items.name: Fairies' Woods, southwest corner
items.howTo: The southwest corner of Fairies' Woods is walled off by trees. Get in from the past and travel to the present with the Tune of Currents or Tune of Ages, then cut the bush in the corner.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 1–2

items.name: Talus Peaks, northernmost peak
items.area: High ledge with a single rock (Past)
items.howTo: On the northernmost peak of Talus Peaks, a high ledge with a single rock. Warp up there with the Tune of Ages and lift the rock.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 1–2

items.name: Talus Peaks, western platform
items.area: Small platform on the western edge (Present)
items.howTo: On the west side of Talus Peaks, stand below the rock formation in the past and warp to the present with the Tune of Ages, then cut the bushes on the high ledge.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 1–3

items.name: Zora Village, southwest corner
items.howTo: In the southwest corner of Zora Village in the past, surface and cut the bushes to find the soil.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 2–4, or the one-time Piece of Heart

items.name: Sea of Storms (linked game)
items.howTo: Linked game only: the Piratians' Sea of Storms area is in the present. With the Mermaid Suit and Zora Scale, go inside the ring of whirlpools and dig on the southernmost piece of land.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 3–5, or the one-time Piece of Heart
